purpose: Use the merged SVG workflow to author one original editable paper-cutout performance, then inspect its actual geometry and complete six-second movie.

course.fitCountSemantics: Unchanged fixed helper control flow and successful receipts; not independent dynamic tracing.

admission.sourceIdentity: Every staged file must match the source-freeze manifest before launch.
admission.supplementaryCapacity: cgroup limits not exposed by current route; host memory is not a cgroup observation.

criteria.decodedForeground: Pillow luminance <128, nonempty and no classified foreground on image edges for all 144 frames.
criteria.contactSheets: Four ordered 36-frame sheets from the same complete decode; no additional encode/decode.

evidence: Exact source freeze and staged manifest
Original supervisor command and tool responses
Importer/exporter raw receipts, stdout/stderr, retained inputs and scene
Full projected geometry and per-frame source/decoded hashes
One decoder's original log and timing
Four selected decoded PNGs and four complete contact sheets
Separate visual review with its actual scope

integration.afterReceiving: Retain the actual generated project.json, update usage/status with observed evidence, add only necessary README discoverability and package entries, build and verify the final package once. No product-course replay for packaging.
integration.browserReceiving: Separate held PR11 gate remains unrun.
integration.unresolvedReadout: Original readout custody is separate; no replay.

limits: A creative consumer course does not requalify the full producers.
Finite movie samples and a simple foreground threshold do not establish arbitrary continuous framing or artistic quality.
Lossless YUV encoding does not imply RGB or browser pixel identity.
The complete sequence will be visually reviewed from retained decoded contact sheets; real-time playback is not implied by contact-sheet inspection.
